This feels right, and I like it a lot. Pasting the link, watching it go find the details, then landing on a filled-out entry in my library — that's exactly the effortless save I was hoping for. Starting empty makes sense too.

The review step is the right idea. One thing I'd want there, though: right now I can add my own notes, but the title and description it found are just sitting there fixed. Sometimes the title a page gives itself is clunky or too long, and I'd want to tidy it up — or fix the description — right there before I save it, without having to go hunt for an edit screen afterward. So the review shouldn't just show me what it found; it should let me adjust the title and description too.

Can you make those editable at that step? Otherwise the saving flow is just what I pictured.
